rv_heading: Our Home away from Home, in detail.
rv_intro: Fourteen photographs of the RV, the complete specification sheet, the Bunkhouse Floorplan, and a full list of what is on board.
rv_spec_intro: A 34-foot Class A gas RV on an automatic transmission. No special license needed — it drives like a Dream. Any figure not listed here can be confirmed from the door sticker on request.
rv_floorplan_text: Front king bedroom with wardrobes, kitchen and booth dinette mid-coach, couches on both sides, and a power fold-away bunk. The Dining Table faces the Couch rather than a wall.
rv_equip_intro: All of the following is on board as standard. Renters typically need only food, clothing and bedding — and bedding is available as an add-on if you would rather not pack it.
